u0: The agent has not yet taken the matching key while the door is shut, and the door has not been opened, so no key-related obligation is pending. From this stage, picking up the matching key activates the requirement that the door later be opened, while opening or already finding the door open resolves that requirement immediately. The agent may move and prepare freely, and this conditional rule imposes nothing more until the key is picked up.
u1: The agent has picked up the matching key while the door was still closed, so the conditional promise is now active. The outstanding requirement is to open the door at some later point; until then, this stage persists even if the key is dropped or no longer carried. Dropping the key does not cancel the obligation, and there is no return to the untriggered stage. Opening the door resolves the requirement and advances to the satisfied condition.
u2: The door-opening event has occurred, so the conditional requirement is satisfied: any earlier pickup of the matching key has been followed by opening the door. If the door was already open without a prior active key obligation, the rule is likewise resolved. Once this happens, later changes cannot undo this satisfaction for the purpose of the rule, even if the door is toggled shut. No further key-opening action is required, though the broader mission of retrieving the designated box may still remain unless the episode has ended.
